<?php
function late158Review() { echo "late|"; return 9; }
$receiver158Review = new class {
    private function accept158Review(int &$head, &$same) {
        echo "private|", $head === 7 ? "head-int|" : "bad-head|";
        $head = 8;
        echo $same === 8 ? "same-cell|" : "bad-alias|";
        $same = "written";
    }
    public function run158Review() {
        $local158Review = "7";
        $alias158Review =& $local158Review;
        $this->accept158Review($local158Review, $alias158Review);
        echo $local158Review, "|";
        try {
            $this->accept158Review(1, late158Review());
        } catch (Error $error158Review) {
            echo $error158Review->getMessage(), "|", $error158Review->getLine(), "|";
        }
        echo "after";
    }
};
$receiver158Review->run158Review();
echo "|done";

<?php
function first158Review($label) { echo $label, "|"; return 1; }
class Base158Review {
    protected function requiredBase158Review($first, $second) { echo "base-body|"; }
}
$receiver158Review = new class extends Base158Review {
    public function requiredOwn158Review($first, $second) { echo "own-body|"; }
    public function run158Review() {
        try {
            $this->requiredBase158Review(first158Review("base-first"));
        } catch (ArgumentCountError $error158Review) {
            echo $error158Review->getMessage(), "|", $error158Review->getLine(), "|";
        }
    }
};
echo "before|";
try {
    $receiver158Review->requiredOwn158Review(first158Review("own-first"));
} catch (ArgumentCountError $error158Review) {
    echo $error158Review->getMessage(), "|", $error158Review->getLine(), "|";
}
$receiver158Review->run158Review();
echo "after";

<?php
$head158 = "7";
$last158 = "4";
$extra158 = "6";
$object158 = new class {
    public $calls = 0;
    public function mix(int &$head, int $middle = 20, int &...$tail): int {
        $this->calls++;
        $head++;
        $tail[0] = 30;
        return $head + $middle + $tail[0] + $tail["last"];
    }
};
$first158 = $object158->mix(head: $head158, last: $last158);
echo $first158, "|", $head158, "|";
echo $last158 === 4 ? "last-int|" : "bad-type|";
$last158 = 7;
$second158 = $object158->mix($head158, 5, $extra158, last: $last158);
echo $second158, "|", $head158, "|", $extra158, "|", $last158, "|", $object158->calls, "|after";

<?php
function late158Author() { echo "late|"; return "bad"; }
$object158 = new class {
    private function hidden(int $value): int { echo "hidden|"; return $value; }
    public function inside(): int { return $this->hidden(8); }
    public function typed(int $first, int $second, int $third, int $fourth): int {
        echo "bad-body|";
        return 1;
    }
};
echo $object158->inside(), "|";
try {
    $object158->hidden(late158Author());
} catch (Error $error158) {
    echo $error158->getMessage(), "|";
}
try {
    $object158->typed(1, 2, 3, late158Author());
} catch (TypeError $error158) {
    echo $error158->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after";

<?php
$source158 = 'namespace Method158Author;
function make158() {
    return new class {
        public $calls = 0;
        public function calculate(int &$value = 7, int $last = 2): int {
            $value += 3;
            $this->calls++;
            return $value + $last;
        }
    };
}';
eval($source158);
$first158 = Method158Author\make158();
$second158 = Method158Author\make158();
echo $first158->calculate(last: 4), "|";
echo $second158->calculate(), "|";
echo $first158->calculate(last: 5), "|", $first158->calls, "|", $second158->calls, "|after";
